signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 encoded message to authenticate API call

accountGuid.description: The Guid of your Independent Reserve account

fromTimestampUtc.description: The timestamp in UTC, specified according to ISO 8601 standard, from which you want to retrieve transactions

toTimestampUtc.description: The timestamp in UTC, specified according to ISO 8601 standard, until which you want to retrieve transactions

txTypes.description: Array of transaction types for filtering

includeTotals.description: Defaults to true for backward compatibility. When set to false, response time is improved.
